title: VERA

title: MIMESIS

title: Quantum Circuit Discovery

title: LongHarness

title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting

title: ReHarness

title: The Agentic Scientist

title: GitSwarm

title: AutoEnvScaling

title: Evolving Agent Interfaces

title: Terminal-RSI

title: Transcoder Features Are Neurons

title: MemoryTax
reason: Measures the cost and accuracy of Mem0, Zep, BM25, and full context across coding agents, showing that searching raw history can beat memory systems and that memory quality is capped by the writer, which sharpens the memory note's claims.
